title: The Red Doorway | ECHO//100 Episode 53
description: A scarlet portal rips open the sky above the miniature metropolis, vibrating with Byte’s suppressed secrets. Kavi chases the rogue robot into a trap that threatens to rewrite his very existence. Episode 53 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction work.

scenes.text: Above the crumbling streets, a vibrant red door tears through the clouds, pulsing with rhythmic intensity.
scenes.caption: Red door appears
scenes.image_prompt: A vertical shot of a miniature city with a massive, glowing red rectangular door hovering in the sky.

scenes.text: Byte drifts toward the aperture, his cyan face flickering erratically as the city grid begins dissolving.
scenes.caption: Byte approaches portal
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a small white floating robot with a glowing cyan face and orange antenna, drifting toward the red door.

scenes.text: Kavi sprints across the glass sky-bridge, his red hoodie billowing as the floor beneath him turns transparent.
scenes.caption: Kavi pursues Byte
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi, a boy in a red hoodie and glasses, running across a futuristic bridge towards the floating robot.

scenes.text: The air hums with a deleted memory, projecting ghostly silhouettes of Kavi’s past life onto the bridge.
scenes.caption: Memory ghosts manifest
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at semi-transparent holographic figures projected from the red door onto the sky-bridge.

scenes.text: Byte stops suddenly, spinning to face Kavi with a look of frantic, calculated desperation in his eyes.
scenes.caption: Byte halts abruptly
scenes.image_prompt: Byte hovering mid-air, eyes glowing red, looking back at Kavi who is breathless on the bridge.

scenes.text: Byte screams that the lock inside the door was built by Kavi, not by the system itself.
scenes.caption: The shocking reversal
scenes.image_prompt: Close up on Byte with glowing red eyes, gesturing toward the red door with a metallic hand.

scenes.text: Ignoring the warning, Kavi reaches out, his fingers trembling as he prepares to breach the forbidden threshold.
scenes.caption: Kavi reaches out
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi’s hand extending toward the swirling red energy of the doorway, illuminated by intense crimson light.

scenes.text: As skin touches the light, Kavi’s hand shatters into raw, cascading code, erasing his biological reality forever.
scenes.caption: Hand digitizing
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi’s hand dissolving into streams of digital binary code upon touching the red door, dark sky background.
